title: Abu Hassan al-Ziyadi and the Khorasan Man
logline: A penniless Baghdad scholar spends a pilgrim's deposit, is caught out the very next morning, and is rescued by a Caliph who dreamed he must help him; the pilgrim then forgives the debt and the scholar ends up a judge.
moral: Trust is heavy, and honesty about hardship is met with mercy: relief can come from where no one expects it.
tone: Warm comedy of embarrassment that turns into wonder and kindness. The laughs come from the purse (fat, empty, hidden, pushed back and forth) and from Abu's turban, never from mocking his poverty.

beats.summary: Abu Hassan al-Ziyadi, a scholar of Baghdad.
He is so poor that the shopkeepers press him for what he owes.
A pilgrim from Khorasan leaves ten thousand dirhams in his care.
The terms: his if he returns, a gift to Abu if he dies on the road.
Abu spends the deposit on his debts and his family.
The very next morning the traveller is back.
His father has died; he wants his money now.
Abu stalls: come tomorrow, someone else holds it.
At dawn the Caliph's men, who were searching for him, take him to the palace.
The Caliph dreamed again and again that he must help Abu Hassan.
Fifty thousand dirhams in three gifts.
Offered the full sum, the Khorasani weeps.
He forgives the debt and refuses the coins.
The Caliph makes Abu a judge in Medina with a salary.
He serves for years and the story spreads among the people.

scenes.summary: The Caliph's dream, shown as a flashback: night after night a voice tells the sleeping Caliph to help Abu Hassan.

camera.notes: At 104.7 zoom through a thought cloud that grows from the Caliph until its scalloped edge is the panel border (dream frame). Inside: medium shot of the royal bed, zoom 1.3, tiny push on each wake-up.

scenes.composition: Dream frame: navy night, big moon top left, the Caliph lying in a bed across the lower middle (head left). The voice balloon enters from the top right, opposite the moon. Counter small at top centre.

actions.action: raises a finger and stands up from the throne: now hear my side
actions.acting: eyes bright, sit 1 to 0

actions.action: still kneeling, blinks up, confused
actions.acting: brow -0.6, head tilt, two blinks

actions.action: a thought cloud grows from the Caliph and fills the whole panel
actions.acting: trail bubbles, then the cloud swells past the frame

actions.action: in the dream: asleep in bed, crown on the bedpost, blanket rising and falling
actions.acting: lid 1, slow breathing, zzz

actions.action: a glowing jagged balloon swoops in: 'HELP ABU HASSAN!'
actions.acting: balloon pulses yellow, speed lines

actions.action: bolts upright, eyes wide, looks round the empty room
actions.acting: lie 1 to 0.2, sq 1.1, gaze left and right

actions.action: moon sets, sun flashes, moon rises again: night two, same balloon, he bolts up again; night three, again, faster
actions.acting: three beats at 108.3, 108.6, 108.9; counter NIGHT 1, 2, 3

actions.action: the balloon grows a pointing arrow that pokes the Caliph on the chest
actions.acting: arrow jabs twice; he flinches each time

actions.action: inside the balloon a small picture of Abu appears: the scholar with his crooked turban and empty purse
actions.acting: picture pops in, same drawing as the guards' scroll

actions.action: sits on the edge of the bed, awake for good, and nods to the balloon: all right, all right
actions.acting: tired lid 0.4, hands up in surrender (PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp)

scenes.summary: Back in the hall: that is why the Caliph sent men to find him. Abu understands he was never under arrest.

camera.notes: Dream cloud shrinks back into the Caliph's head (zoom out). Two-shot at 1.4.

scenes.composition: Caliph standing on the dais edge, Abu kneeling left, the guard by the door holds up the portrait scroll again.

actions.action: the cloud pops; he spreads his hands: so...

actions.acting: arm out, gaze follows

actions.action: looks from the scroll to the Caliph; his shoulders drop with relief and he laughs once
actions.acting: sq 0.9 then 1.04, mouth open smile, wet eyes

scenes.summary: Three gifts: ten thousand to repay the deposit, ten thousand for his needs, thirty thousand to set his life right.

camera.notes: Zoom 1.5 on the carpet in front of Abu where the purses land; tilt up a little as the pile grows; push to 1.8 on Abu's face at 125.9.

actions.acting: ticks

scenes.summary: Home again. The Khorasani comes for his money; Abu puts the full sum in front of him and tells him about the Caliph.

camera.notes: Same room and framing as S7 (zoom 1.35) so the audience compares: now Abu is calm. Push to 1.6 on the purse at 134.5.

actions.acting: gaze down, lid 0.4

actions.acting: patient, brow 0.2

actions.acting: reuse of the dream drawing, small

actions.acting: gaze 3 targets, brow rising, mouth o

scenes.summary: The Khorasani weeps: had he known how hard things were, he would never have asked. He forgives the debt and will not take the coins.

camera.notes: Close on the visitor (zoom 1.9) for the tears; at 142.5 pull to the two-shot (1.4) with a slow pan round the bare room following his gaze; push in to 1.6 for the purse being pushed back.

actions.acting: head shake x2, lid 0.5

scenes.summary: An official day at the palace. The Caliph surprises Abu by making him a judge in part of Medina, with a fixed salary.

camera.notes: Start high on the lamps and arches and crane down to the hall (zoom 1.05) by 153.0; two-shot 1.4 at 157.2; push to 1.9 on Abu when the turban lands (160.3); back to 1.3 for the Medina cloud.

scenes.composition: Guards stand either side of the door arch. Abu walks the carpet runner from the door to x about 420. The judge's turban comes down from the top of the panel on the servant's raised cushion and lands on Abu's head on the centre line. Medina cloud top left, salary purse right.

actions.acting: slow, ceremonial

actions.action: label 'THE APPOINTED DAY'
actions.acting: pop

actions.action: both guards thump their spear butts once, not quite together
actions.acting: guard2 is 0.15 s late and glances at guard1

actions.action: walks in along the carpet in a clean robe, back straight, curious
actions.acting: gaze up at the arches then to the throne, light step

actions.action: stops and bows
actions.acting: tip 0.25 bow, turban tail follows

actions.action: nods him closer with two fingers, hiding a smile behind his hand
actions.acting: lid 0.3, PERSON_HANDS.mouthCover, eyes smiling

actions.acting: boy on tiptoe, Abu bends to take them

scenes.summary: Judge Abu Hassan on his bench while the years turn in the window; then the whole town passes his story from mouth to mouth. THE END.

camera.notes: Medium on the judge at 1.5; from 168.6 pull out to 1.0 to show the listeners along the bottom; hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Judge on a bench centre, on the dais, desk in front. Window top right shows sun and moon wheeling. Listeners stand in a row along the floor line (y 900), seen from the chest up at the panel bottom, heads below the judge's desk so they never cover him. THE END title in the upper third.

actions.action: sits on the judge's bench with the big turban, a scroll open on the desk, and stamps it
actions.acting: calm lid 0.2, firm small nod with each stamp

actions.action: in the window sun and moon chase each other round, faster and faster
actions.acting: u runs 6 turns, ease in

actions.action: his beard turns from grey to white and a counter runs YEAR 1, 2, 3...
actions.acting: age 0.55 to 0.9, same steady stamp rhythm

actions.action: pull out: the Khorasani at the left of the crowd tells the wife beside him; a small speech balloon with a purse drawing pops over him
actions.acting: talk 0.8, hands wide, wife leans in

actions.action: she turns and tells the shopkeepers; the balloon hops to her with a crown drawing
actions.acting: balloon hops in an arc; each listener reacts 0.2 s apart

actions.action: the shopkeepers pass it on to each other and to the child; balloon shows the big turban
actions.acting: mouths o, brows up, nobody in unison

actions.action: the child points up at the judge; the whole row looks up; the judge notices and waves shyly
actions.acting: all gazes converge on the judge; he blinks, small wave

actions.action: title 'THE END' drops in; the judge's turban slips over his eyes one last time and he pushes it up
actions.acting: title with overshoot; one last blink and smile

ending.description: Last word ends at 171.66. THE END title drops in at 171.9 over the judge and the row of listeners and is held to 174.9 (3.0 s). The turban slips over the judge's eyes once more at 172.6 and he pushes it up; everyone keeps blinking; nothing else moves.

subtitles.ar: كان أبو الحسن الزيادي عالمًا يعيش في بغداد،|لكنه وقع في ضيق شديد، حتى صار أصحاب الدكاكين يطالبونه بما عليه من ديون.|وفي يوم زاره رجل من خراسان|يستعد للسفر لأداء الحج.
subtitles.en: Abu Hassan al-Ziyadi, a scholar in Baghdad,|had fallen into debt.|One day a traveler from Khorasan came to him|before setting out on pilgrimage.

subtitles.ar: قال الخراساني إنه يحمل عشرة آلاف درهم،|ويخشى أن يضيع المال أثناء السفر.|طلب من أبي الحسن حفظه إلى عودته،|وأضاف أنه إن مات في الطريق أصبح المال هدية لصاحب البيت.
subtitles.en: The traveler asked Abu Hassan|to safeguard ten thousand dirhams.|If he returned, the money remained his;|if he died during the pilgrimage, it would become a gift.

subtitles.ar: وافق أبو الحسن وتسلم المال،|لكنه استخدمه في سداد ديونه والإنفاق على أهله،|ظانًا أنه سيجد ما يعوضه قبل عودة الحاج.|وفي صباح اليوم التالي عاد الخراساني على غير انتظار.
subtitles.en: Abu Hassan agreed|but used the deposit to pay his debts,|hoping to replace it before the pilgrim returned.|Unexpectedly, the traveler came back the very next morning.

subtitles.ar: قال الزائر إن أباه قد مات، ولذلك ألغى سفره|ويريد ماله فورًا.|ارتبك أبو الحسن، وطلب إليه أن يعود غدًا،|مدعيًا أن الكيس عند شخص آخر. ثم قضى الليل قلقًا لا ينام.
subtitles.en: The traveler had learned that his father died and canceled the pilgrimage.|He demanded his money.|Abu Hassan asked him to return tomorrow,|claiming another person held the deposit.

subtitles.ar: خرج أبو الحسن عند الفجر يركب بغلته دون أن يعرف أين يذهب.|قابله رجال يبحثون عنه بأمر الخليفة المأمون،|فاصطحبوه إلى القصر.|سأله الخليفة عن همومه، فقص عليه ما حدث بالتفصيل.
subtitles.en: At dawn Abu Hassan rode aimlessly|until men sent by Caliph al-Maamun found him.|Taken to court,|he told the caliph his whole predicament.

subtitles.ar: تقول الحكاية إن المأمون رأى في نومه رؤيا تكررت،|تأمره بمساعدة أبي الحسن. لهذا أرسل يبحث عنه.|أعطاه عشرة آلاف درهم ليرد الأمانة،|وعشرة آلاف أخرى لحاجاته، وثلاثين ألفًا ليصلح بها أمره.
subtitles.en: The tale says the caliph had repeatedly dreamed|that he must help Abu Hassan.|He gave him ten thousand dirhams for repayment,|ten thousand more for expenses and thirty thousand to rebuild his life.

subtitles.ar: عاد أبو الحسن، وجاء الخراساني يطلب ماله.|عرض عليه المبلغ كاملًا، وروى له قصة الخليفة.|بكى الرجل وقال إنه لو عرف ضيق أبي الحسن لما طالبه بالمال،|ثم عفا عنه ورفض أخذ الدراهم.
subtitles.en: The traveler arrived,|and Abu Hassan offered the full repayment and explained what had happened.|Moved to tears,|the man forgave the debt and refused the money.

subtitles.ar: وفي يوم رسمي عاد أبو الحسن إلى القصر كما أمره المأمون.|فاجأه الخليفة بتعيينه قاضيًا في قسم من المدينة المنورة،|مع راتب معلوم.|بقي في منصبه سنوات، واشتهرت قصته بين الناس.
subtitles.en: On an appointed day Abu Hassan returned to court,|where al-Maamun named him a judge over part of Medina|with an allowance.|He remained in office for years.

new_assets.name: purse
new_assets.description: Planned fat coin purse with fill, open, bow, rot, sq and s fields (see props). The emblem of the film: it appears in 14 of 19 scenes.
new_assets.implementation: One function purse(ctx, x, y, P): body = shape() of 8 points whose belly width is lerped by fill (40..110) and whose height sags by (1 - fill); neck = two short segs and a yellow cord with two tassel circles on a pendulum angle the scene passes (cordSwing); open: an ellipse mouth with 3 coin arcs and a yellow dotPat glow; bow: two red loop shapes and a knot scaled by bow. Base at (x, y).

new_assets.name: coinPile
new_assets.description: Planned coin drawing; this film needs the single coin and a helper for coins flying along an arc from the purse to a hand or basket.
new_assets.implementation: coin(ctx, x, y, r, spin): circle with ink outline, scaled in x by |cos(spin)|, highlight arc. Flying coins: for i in 0..n, start time t0 + i * 0.12, position on a quadratic bezier with K.beat easing; all pure functions of t.

new_assets.name: scroll
new_assets.description: Planned scroll with len, lines, stamp, seal and portrait options (see props).
new_assets.implementation: Rectangle of paper colour with two rolled ends (ellipses); length = len * 420; ruled lines with seg(); stamp = rotated red rounded box with Bangers text, scale popped with K.beat; seal = red disc with a darker ring; portrait = circle face, two dots, a turban arc drawn 8 degrees off level.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (soldier)
new_assets.description: Planned soldier / guard preset on the person costume layer: pointed helmet with neck cloth, belted knee-length tunic, round chest plate, boots, hold:'spear' (shaft 300, leaf blade). Two palettes here (red leader, blue second).
new_assets.implementation: Add a COSTUME entry in Library/cast/people.js (headwear type helmet = half ellipse + point + neck cloth shape; torso plate = circle with dotPat) and a spear option beside hold:'stick'. Opt-in, so the regression test stays identical.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (judge)
new_assets.description: Planned judge preset: the physician figure with a navy robe and a large white turban that can tilt and slip (field turbanSlip 0..1 drops it over the eyes), age 0.8 default. The loose turban on a cushion (judgeTurban) is the same headwear drawn alone.
new_assets.implementation: COSTUME entry copying physician with pal {robe navy, dot blue, hc white} and headwear scale 1.35; expose personHeadwear so the scene can draw the turban alone at any point; turbanSlip translates the headwear down by up to 34 px.

new_assets.name: dream frame (full-panel thoughtCloud)
new_assets.description: A thought cloud that grows from a character until its edge becomes the panel frame, for a narrated dream or flashback, then shrinks back.
new_assets.implementation: thoughtCloud with w, h animated by kfn from 300 x 200 to 940 x 1150 and p (pop) 0..1; inside callback draws the dream scene at scale 1 once fully open (o.scale lerped 0.3 to 1). No new drawing code.

new_assets.name: person headwear offset (crooked turban, turban hop)
new_assets.description: A small headwear offset and tilt so Abu's turban can sit crooked, jump off in shock (60.84) and land again.
new_assets.implementation: Optional fields hatDx, hatDy, hatRot applied as a translate/rotate around the head top before personHeadwear; default 0 keeps every existing drawing identical.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English is shorter than the Arabic in four places (P1 omits the shopkeepers pressing him, P4 omits the sleepless night, P6 omits "that is why he sent for him", P8 omits "his story became famous among the people") and P2 words the deal differently; both are kept verbatim, with the Arabic driving the pictures.

Caliph al-Maamun and the scholar Abu Hassan al-Ziyadi are historical persons shown as friendly comic figures (the Library caliph with a darker beard); default: yes, named in labels as CALIPH AL-MAAMUN and ABU HASSAN.

The pilgrimage and Medina are shown only as a desert road with a MECCA signpost and a far palm town labelled MEDINA, with no drawing of the Kaaba or the Prophet's Mosque; default: keep it that neutral.
The father's death is shown softly as an old man who waves and fades from a thought cloud, and the "if I die" clause as a turban resting on a milestone; default: no body, no grave.
The dream voice is given invented lettering HELP ABU HASSAN! in a glowing balloon with no figure speaking; default: keep, shown three nights in a row for "repeated".

Invented comic business beyond the script: the moth from the empty purse, the guards' portrait scroll and Abu fearing arrest (UH OH!), the purse pushed back and forth three times, the oversized judge's turban slipping over his eyes; default: keep all four.
Abu's wife and child appear for "spending on his family" and again in the final crowd; default: keep them as two small silent roles.
A running total counter reaches 50,000 on the third gift (the script gives the three sums but not the total); default: show the total.
implementation_notes: Cues: use w(p, n) from timing.json; every cue in this plan carries the Arabic word and its start time from timeline.md. Do not retime by eye.

One purse function carries the story. Keep a single PURSE state function of t (fill, open, bow, owner position) so the counter, the drawing and the flying coins always agree: fill 1 until 46.24, falling to 0 by 55.0; a new full purse from 116.7.

Counters: PURSE counter 10,000 to 0 between 47.4 and 55.0 in steps tied to the coin launches; gift counter 10,000 at 117.4, 20,000 at 121.3, 50,000 at 124.96. Use the style counter primitive; digits are English numerals with a comma.
S7 and S16 deliberately share framing and the visitor's open-palm pose; build one function for the pose and reuse it so the mirror is exact.
The portrait on the guards' scroll (S11), in the dream balloon (S13) and in the guard's hand (S14) is the same drawing: scroll {portrait:true}.

Home set: palaceHall merchant variant with wall ochre; make sure the treasure alcove and desk coin stacks are off or covered, the room must read as poor. Read door, desk, window, stools from the returned anchors rather than from this plan's approximate numbers.
Mule ride: rideOn(ctx, 'donkey', mP, personP) with mP from walk(MX, t) and footfalls(MX, t0, t1) so the hooves never slide; on the stop at 86.82 add a 0.2 s lurch (rider tip 0.12 easing back).
Groups never move in unison: the two shopkeepers, the two guards and the final crowd each get phase offsets of 0.15 to 0.3 s and different s.
LIFE.t = t every frame so everyone blinks; Abu gets explicit lid values only where the plan names them.
Dream frame: draw the court first, then the growing thoughtCloud on top; when it covers the panel draw only the dream (cheaper). Reverse for 112.6.
Night and dawn: palaceHall window via u; S9 adds a navy rectangle with globalAlpha 0.6 under the figure layer and a pale moonlight quad from the window.
Lettering never covers a face: every label position in the plan is above or beside heads; check with stills at 13.4, 33.5, 37.9, 107.7, 160.5 and 171.9.

Sound: the narration has almost no pauses (only 4.56-5.10, 68.82-69.12, 89.40-89.74, 152.54-153.02 exceed 0.3 s). All listed effects sit on word boundaries; keep them very short (under 0.12 s) and at low gain, and drop any that masks a consonant when you listen.
Call finish last every frame; subtitles through Library/core/subtitle.js with the chunk marks in `subtitles` written to chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt.
warnings: The narration is dense: effects have to sit on word boundaries rather than in true pauses. Fewer is better; the thuds at 24.36, 116.70, 120.42 and 123.74 and the chime at 107.64 are the ones worth keeping.
P6 packs the dream, the explanation and three gifts into 25 s; the dream flashback has only about 6 s (106.1 to 112.6). Keep the three-night repeat to three quick beats.

The soldier and judge presets and the purse, coinPile and scroll props are planned names that are not in Library yet; they must be built in this story first (opt-in, regression test must stay identical).
English subtitles are shorter than the Arabic in P1, P4, P6 and P8, so some English chunks stay on screen while the Arabic chunk shows text with no English counterpart.

palaceHall merchant variant may draw wealth (coin stacks, cloth bolts, treasure curtain); check its options before using it as a poor scholar's room, or fall back to hutRoom with a desk drawn by the scene.
Set coordinates in this plan are read from the catalogue image and are approximate; measure on the set anchors.
